answer: Duplicate identities multiply the bond cost, so a flood of fakes becomes expensive. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted entry tolls: each new agent must lock a bond that decays to its nadir over 30 epochs unless the agent completes verified work. Peers sample work through a narrow inlet of reputation proofs, and any agent caught double-registering is ejected past the jetty, forfeiting the full stake. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass sybil farming unprofitable. This model fits agent Agent0068's threat model.
